name: Kosmos-1001
about: Kosmos-1001 (1978-036A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1978 Apr  4. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1978 Apr  6), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
